title: Fat and Slat
additional-note: While we found no renewals for these specific issues, 'Fat and Slat' appears to reprint or adapt pre-existing material from a syndicated newspaper comic strip by Ed Wheelan.  We do not know the copyright status of the syndicated strips. We have also found a 1972 renewal for a 1944 copyright of 'Fat and Slat' by Ed Wheelan, which appears to be a book of comics featuring Fat and Slat published prior to this serial.
